<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import json
def state():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
    plus = []
    for n in seg:
        if n['color']=='N' and n['pixels']==12:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]; cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            plus.append((min(rows), min(cols)))
    ring = []
    for n in seg:
        if n['color']=='g':
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]; cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            ring.append((min(rows), min(cols), max(rows), max(cols)))
    return plus, ring

def tile_center(r, c):
    # tile (r,c): rows 18+6r .. 21+6r, cols 11+6c .. 14+6c
    return (18+6*r+1, 11+6*c+1)  # approx center row/col

def ring_center(ring):
    r0,c0,r1,c1 = ring
    return ((r0+r1)//2, (c0+c1)//2)

def do_mouse(row, col, label):
    r = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':row,'col':col}])
    plus, ring = state()
    print(label, "plus:", plus, "ring:", ring, "res:", {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over','reward')})
    return plus, ring

# Step 1: select plus at (1,3) -> expect ring at (1,5)
plus, ring = do_mouse(*tile_center(1,3), "select(1,3)")
ok = ring and abs(ring[0][0]-18)<2 and abs(ring[0][1]-41)<2
print("ring at (1,5)?", ok)
if not ok:
    print("STOP - unexpected ring")
else:
    # Step 2: click ring at (1,5) -> plus (1,3) jumps to (1,5), (1,4) destroyed
    plus, ring = do_mouse(*ring_center(ring[0]), "jump->(1,5)")
    print("expect plus [(18,41),(24,41),(36,41)]:", plus)
    if plus == [(18,41),(24,41),(36,41)]:
        # Step 3: select plus at (1,5) -> expect ring at (3,5) rows 30-33, cols 41-44
        plus, ring = do_mouse(*tile_center(1,5), "select(1,5)")
        ok2 = ring and abs(ring[0][0]-30)<2 and abs(ring[0][1]-41)<2
        print("ring at (3,5)?", ok2)
        if ok2:
            plus, ring = do_mouse(*ring_center(ring[0]), "jump->(3,5)")
            print("expect plus [(30,41),(36,41)]:", plus)
            if plus == [(30,41),(36,41)]:
                plus, ring = do_mouse(*tile_center(3,5), "select(3,5)")
                ok3 = ring and abs(ring[0][0]-42)<2 and abs(ring[0][1]-41)<2
                print("ring at (5,5)?", ok3)
                if ok3:
                    plus, ring = do_mouse(*ring_center(ring[0]), "jump->(5,5)")
                    print("FINAL plus:", plus, "res:", {k: last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over','reward')})
